response.justification: The candidate lacks the mandatory 5–10 years of professional C++ development experience on Windows platform, as their C++ experience is limited to a single role at National Instruments (~6 months) and minor projects. While they have strong technical skills in other areas (Node.js, Dlang, JavaScript), their domain expertise in capital markets or fixed income is nonexistent, and their focus on web/mobile/embedded systems does not align with the role's core requirements.
strengths: Strong problem-solving and software craftsmanship skills (TDD, CI/CD, pairing)
Experience with low-latency and high-performance systems (DLang, fiber-based apps)
Diverse technical background with proficiency in multiple languages and frameworks
concerns: Insufficient C++ experience on Windows platform (mandatory skill)
No domain expertise in capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking
Lacks required SQL Server/Oracle experience (only mentions generic SQL and MongoDB)
